description: A software cryptographic module residing within a trusted virtual machine, V-OS that provides a secure sandboxed operating environment. The Module provides symmetric ciphers including AES and Triple DES, asymmetric cipher RSA, secure hash functions SHA-1 and SHA-256, random number generation, message authentication and key derivation and storage.
